description: Explain where taps on a link go. With slug or url: walks the link through the common channels (Android Chrome, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook in-app browsers, iPhone Safari and Instagram, iPad, computer, preview bot) and returns one row per channel with the decision, where the tap is sent and the reason. A simulation: nothing is recorded. With token: reads a Live Tap Trace from the straitlink.in demo (the st value of a demo.strait.link/try link), i.e. what happened to a real tap.

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

token.description: Demo trace token (st=…) instead of a link

name: trace_tap
title: Trace taps on a link
